function.arguments: {"finding": "The `customer_age` column contains 108 values of -1, which are sentinel values for missing data, not actual ages. Among the 301 customers who converted, 34 have age -1. Including these in the mean would bias the result downward, as -1 is not a real age. Therefore, they must be excluded from the mean calculation.", "implication": "The mean age must be computed only on converted customers with valid (non -1) ages. The population is not all `converted == 1`, but all `converted == 1` and `customer_age != -1`. This changes the population definition."}
function.name: note_finding
